question: Does NOAA-20, converted with the frozen ratio method, reproduce nominal-orbit Aqua MODIS daytime monthly detection counts in regions never used to build it?

window.design: leave-one-year-out; every scored month was predicted by a fit that excluded its whole year, with Aqua hidden

q3_status.label: M1 S-NPP method replicated 2012-2017 (secondary; cannot change Q1)
M1 S-NPP method replicated 2012-2017 (secondary; cannot change Q1)

q1.label: SUCCESS
q1.scope: expanded5, D, primary window, n20_ratio_direct, Weibull (HF type 6) intervals (intervals.quantile_method.q1; the classifier reads the Q1 lo/hi columns, which are Weibull), all folds pooled

sensitivity_end_2021_06.label: sensitivity outcome; never replaces the primary outcome

q2.label: sensor effect, same folds: NOAA-20 minus S-NPP (secondary; cannot change Q1)

q3.label: M1 method (S-NPP -> Aqua) replicated in the same regions, 2012-2017 (secondary)
q3.margin_note: passed the Clopper-Pearson rule by a very small margin; one fewer covered month would not pass

rule.truth: native Aqua class vs MODIS 2003-2011 reference (site rule aqua_p10_p90_interval_v1)
rule.wrong_decisive_definition: decided months that disagreed, as a share of ALL rows (abstentions included; includes misses); not 1 - agreement
rule.agreement_denominator: months where both truth and arm are decided
rule.range_crosses_edge: per-month tag only (90% range straddles p10 or p90); not a verdict and no agreement rate is computed on it
rule.classification: point value vs plain envelope (index 0 of the reference resamples): above if v > p90, below if v < p10, else within; cant_tell if n_years < min_years, no value, or (modelled arm and native NOAA-20 < low_count_threshold)

viirs_era_arm.site_label: within-VIIRS-era ranking: rankings within one satellite era cannot stand in for rankings across eras
viirs_era_arm.crosstab_label: agreement between within-era rankings — evidence about comparability, not an equivalence claim
viirs_era_arm.role: descriptive only; never pooled or ranked with other arms
viirs_era_arm.note: point value R_NS*N vs S-NPP 2012-2017 envelope; truth = native Aqua vs Aqua 2003-2011 envelope; the reference also differs in period (2012-2017), so the disagreement is not a pure sensor effect

confusion.cols: arm class (native NOAA-20 x link vs S-NPP 2012-2017 reference)

frozen_labels.q4.primary_pool|viirs_era_arm.label: within-VIIRS-era ranking; not comparable to MODIS-era rankings
frozen_labels.note: stored verbatim; the site shows pooled.q4.viirs_era_arm.site_label instead (M2-AUDIT §3/§9 wording)

provenance.q4_confusion_orientation: q4.json confusion_truth_x_arm is pd.crosstab(truth, arm).to_dict(): outer key = ARM class, inner key = TRUTH class. Exported here transposed as counts[truth][arm] (rows = truth, cols = arm) and re-derived from month_rows; the frozen file is unchanged (M2-AUDIT §3).
provenance.featured_month_rule: JOURNEY §3: per region, months sorted ascending; index = int(sha256(f'{lock_id}:{region}'), 16) mod n; fixed before outcomes were seen; misses ship as misses
provenance.selection: predictions_q1.parquet rows with analysis_set == 'primary', daynight == 'D'; every held-out month is listed (no subsetting, misses included)

notes: Every held-out month of the 5 primary regions is listed; the denominator of every pooled number is all of them, misses included.
Detections are satellite hotspot detections, not fires.
Validated for 2018-04..2021-12 nominal-orbit daytime months only. Converted NOAA-20 values for 2022 onward are converted_unvalidated (Aqua drifting; post-MODIS stationarity untested).
The VIIRS-era arm is agreement between within-era rankings: evidence about comparability, not an equivalence claim; never pooled or ranked with the other arms.
Numbers are copied from analysis/results_m2/confirm (read-only); per-month Q4 classes are re-derived with the frozen rule and must reproduce q4.json's confusion matrices exactly.
